description: Source code for the AdvancedPage class in MenuLibre, a GTK-based application for editing desktop menu entries. Defines a GTK widget with multiple configurable rows for desktop entry properties.

classes.name: AdvancedPage
classes.description: A GTK widget for editing advanced desktop entry properties, with multiple configurable rows and signals.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AdvancedPage widget, sets up the grid layout, and adds property rows.

methods.name: _add_row
methods.description: Adds a labeled row with a widget to the grid layout, connecting signals and storing references.

methods.name: _on_widget_value_changed
methods.description: Handles value change signals from child widgets and emits a 'value-changed' signal.

methods.name: has_value
methods.description: Checks if a property name exists in the widget collection.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the value of a property widget if it exists.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property widget if it exists.
